scripts.check: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=shared doppler run -- turbo check build && bun run i18n:check
scripts.dev: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=shared doppler run -- turbo dev
scripts.preview: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=shared doppler run -- turbo run preview --filter=@gamezilla/db --filter=@gamezilla/api --filter=@gamezilla/client
scripts.qa: env -u CURSOR_AGENT -u CURSOR_TRACE_ID DOPPLER_CONFIG=shared doppler run -- turbo run qa --filter=@gamezilla/qa
scripts.i18n:check: lingui extract && lingui compile --typescript && git diff --exit-code -- apps/client/src/i18n libs/lib/src/i18n libs/patch-db-example/src/i18n libs/room-example/src/i18n
